propositions: The _fold_heads function currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD rather than the published ref tip, making the result dependent on the checked-out branch.
The _require_tracker_on_ref guard refuses the heal when current_branch != ref or the HEAD is detached, preventing healing of such trackers.
_fold_heads must be rewritten to use git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree to fold into refs/heads/<ref> without requiring a worktree checkout.
The merge=ours driver for .bridge_state/* files is not validated by existing tests; a new regression test must verify the fold preserves the tracker's side on collision.
After an off-branch heal, the checked-out branch and worktree must remain unchanged; after an on-branch heal, git status must be empty.
The refusal guard and its docstring must be deleted and replaced with a narrow pre-download guard that refuses only when the ref is checked out and the worktree is dirty.
